cards.name: Summer Camps
cards.description: Participants rehearse a JR or KIDS musical adaptation and work on performance or technical theatre tasks such as props, sets, costumes, lights and sound. Camps typically include two weeks of rehearsals followed by a weekend of performances.

prices.label: No enrollment, participation, or materials fees

cards.review_notes: The official policies PDF identifies Shrek the Musical KIDS as the 2026 summer camp; the theatre FAQ gives Shrek KIDS eligibility as K–12th grade. No readable session dates were found. The day format is inferred from the rehearsal-based camp description; daily hours are unknown. The programs directory places McDowell Children's Theatre on site at MACA. Check embedded audition documents and the Summer 2027 graphic for updated offerings and dates.

cards.name: Page to Stage
cards.description: Participants attend guest workshops and write, direct, handle technical work, costume and produce their own short plays. The one-week program ends with four performances over a weekend.

prices.label: No enrollment, participation, or materials fees

cards.review_notes: The official policies PDF explicitly includes Page to Stage in the 2026 season. No readable session dates were found. The day format is inferred from the workshop and production description; daily hours are unknown. The programs directory places McDowell Children's Theatre on site at MACA. The Summer 2027 heading alone does not establish whether Page to Stage returns; check the unreadable embedded audition documents and show graphics.
